title: A $4,200 Lab-Grown Diamond Now Costs Just $380
hook: The same lab-grown diamond fell from $4,200 to $380.
closing: Lab-grown diamonds made size cheaper, but their resale value collapsed too.
question: Natural or lab-grown: which would you pick?

segments.say: A lab-grown diamond that cost $4,200 now sells for a fraction of that. Luxury pricing collapsed.
A lab-grown diamond costs $380, making its natural twin thousands more expensive.
Lab-grown diamonds now appear in 47 percent of engagement rings. Buyers followed the lower price.
